title: SPARC Cat - Sham Control Chronic Cat 1, Day 0
author: Brett Hanzlicek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfzajp2e
materials: Transport cat from housing site to surgery site.
Empty Bladder Cat transitioned back to isoflurane

steps.title: Prepare Animal for Surgery
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the cat, shave the abdomen, and move the animal to the surgery room to be attached to monitors.

steps.title: Sterilize Surgical Site
steps.instruction: Drape the animal and perform a betadine scrub on the abdomen and genitals.

steps.title: Insert Bladder Catheter
steps.instruction: Insert a 3.5Fr catheter lubricated with surgilube into the bladder via the urethra.

substeps.instruction: Advance the catheter until resistance is met

steps.title: Perform Initial Urinalysis
steps.instruction: Use gentle suction with a syringe to withdraw urine from the bladder through the catheter.

substeps.instruction: Measure the volume of urine removed (e.g., 28 mL)

steps.title: Visualize Bladder via CT
steps.instruction: Use a 1:5 dilution of contrast to saline to visualize the bladder using CT imaging.

substeps.instruction: Fill the bladder with 10 mL contrast and take a single CT image
Add 20 mL more contrast (total 30 mL) and take a single CT image
Take a 3D CT image with 30 mL contrast:saline in the bladder

steps.title: Measure Bladder Pressure
steps.instruction: After transferring the cat from Isoflurane to propofol anesthetic, record bladder pressure using Labview software and an external pressure transducer connected to a syringe pump.

substeps.instruction: Set saline fill rate to 2 mL/minute using the syringe pump
Fill bladder with saline and record peak pressure at the following volumes: 19 mL (4.5 cm H2O), 20 mL (5.0 cm H2O), 30 mL, 40 mL (10.7 cm H2O), 42 mL (11 cm H2O), and 47.5 mL (20 cm H2O)

steps.title: Insert Device into Bladder
steps.instruction: Access and open the bladder for device insertion following the 'SPARC Cat surgery Day 0' protocol.

substeps.instruction: Place the device in the bladder
Suture the bladder closed with 4-5 stitches
Add 25 mL of dilute contrast through the catheter to check for leaks
Place the bladder back into the body

steps.title: Perform Post-Insertion Imaging
steps.instruction: Take a DYNA-CT picture and a 3D CT image.

steps.title: Remove Device and Close Incision
steps.instruction: Remove the device and close the surgical site following the 'SPARC Cat surgery Day 0' protocol.

steps.title: Perform Final Pressure Check
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline at 2 mL/min and record pressure.

substeps.instruction: Fill to 4 mL (note when pressure starts to rise)
Fill to 18 mL (peak pressure 10 cm H2O)
Fill to 20 mL (peak pressure 10 cm H2O)

steps.title: Recovery
steps.instruction: Wait for the cat to wake up and return it to the housing site.
